Nina (AE): Quick: vendor risk asked who holds encryption keys for Hosted/Dedicated/Private and whether raw prompts are stored. Need a one-paragraph CAIQ-ready blurb and an attestation.

Omar (Security): Hosted = Redwood-managed keys by default; BYOK available (AWS/GCP KMS, HSM on request). Dedicated = configurable KMS (customer or Redwood-managed by contract). Private = customer-managed KMS only.

Lee (Solutions Eng): Logs: default retention 30 days for hosted ops. For POCs we can enable ephemeral mode (no persistent raw prompt storage) and export audit logs to customer projects.

Cal (Vendor Risk): Also need a short attestation statement saying Redwood staff cannot read plaintext without approved, logged access. A sample audit extract would help.

Omar (Security): Attestation sample: "Redwood enforces RBAC and separation of duties; any runtime access to decrypted customer data requires an approved ticket and is logged in immutable audit records." I'll attach a sanitized rotation/audit sample and a one-pager CAIQ mapping.

redwood-ops-bot: Uploaded: https://internal.redwood/drive/caiq-byo-attest-1825.pdf (caiq-byo-attest-1825.pdf)

Nina (AE): Thanks all — I'll send this to the vendor team with the attachments.

Cal (Vendor Risk): That should do for intake. May ask for rotation timestamps later.

Omar (Security): Noted, can provide sanitized rotation entries if requested. ETA EOD.
